content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

The exclusion of creators in specific countries from platforms like Stripe and PayPal is not just an inconvenience; it's a structural barrier that limits their potential. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 worldwide, leaving many creators without the means to collect payments seamlessly. This limitation creates a gap, but it also presents an opportunity for alternative infrastructures that enable digital creators to regain control over their sales processes and financial transactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a foundational layer that bypasses the need for traditional payment processors. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, creators can establish their online stores. This setup ensures automatic payment verification and instant product delivery without the constraints imposed by platforms that lock users out due to geographic restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and beyond, where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It empowers creators to sell digital products such as courses, ebooks, and templates without the fear of account suspensions or payment rejections. The architecture allows them to operate independently, fostering a sense of sovereignty over their digital endeavors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to regain control over their sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce infrastructure consists of several key components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting environment, while Google Sheets or Supabase manage order storage. For crypto payment processing, NOWPayments seamlessly integrates into this stack, ensuring that transactions are verified instantly. This interconnected system not only enhances efficiency but also ensures full ownership and control over the sales process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling courses without relying on conventional platforms, begin by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack for $197. This stack is deployed within 48 hours and includes essential components like Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. Next, load your products, configure your SPF/DKIM/DMARC settings, and conduct end-to-end testing. Finally, leverage the 30-day support to troubleshoot any issues and launch your store confidently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure to sell digital products. This approach allows you to build your online store using tools that bypass traditional payment processors and grant you full ownership of your sales process. You can utilize platforms like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, eliminating the need for accounts that may not be accessible in your region.
Eliminate dependency on platforms that restrict access based on geography.
